title: Capture every official schedule for the trip dates
why: Only three resorts (Wynn, Venetian, Bellagio) are captured. Other rooms are missing (F21).
options: A. Keep the current 3 resorts (fastest).
B. Add ARIA, MGM Grand, Resorts World, Caesars, Golden Nugget, Orleans, South Point, Planet Hollywood (more complete; more time).
C. Limit to the 2 resorts with the most events (Wynn and Venetian).
recommend: B for completeness, once trip dates are known.

title: Check each single-entry event's structure sheet for re-entry and add-on rules
why: Only 4 event structures were checked (F22). Single-entry status for the rest is pending.
options: A. Check all Venetian and Wynn structure sheets (complete; slow).
B. Check only events on the chosen trip dates (faster).
C. Keep as pending and label clearly (fastest; weakest).
recommend: B, once trip dates are chosen.

title: Add a dated rate capture and a resort-fee source for each hotel
why: Nightly rates and most resort fees are blank because no official dated source was captured (F15).
options: A. Record rates for the trip's exact dates from official booking pages, with capture time.
B. Use one official resort-fee page per property (fees only).
C. Hire no outside data; leave rates blank until the trip is booked.

title: Measure walking times with a standard method
why: Walking minutes are blank for every hotel (F18). The 30-minute rule cannot yet be applied.
options: A. Use a walking-route tool and record minutes with the route date.
B. Use official property maps for distance only (less accurate for time).
C. Apply a straight-line distance filter first, then check walking routes for finalists.
recommend: C, then A for the finalists.

title: Decide how to handle the 8 AM start
why: No verified event starts before 10:10 AM (F17).
options: A. Plan from 10:00–11:10 AM starts (what the official schedules support).
B. Add cash-game sessions for the 8 AM block (not tournaments; needs room confirmation).
C. Drop the 8 AM goal from the plan.
recommend: A now; ask the room about early cash games (B) as a separate question.

title: Add a trip planner page
why: The site is read-only. A planner would let you pick dates, budget and hotel tier and see the matching events and hotels.
options: A. Add a simple date and budget filter on the Tournaments and Schedule pages (static, no backend).
B. Add a planner page that stores choices in the browser (no server).
C. Keep the site as a static reference (no change).

title: Add a 'last verified' date and a verification checklist per row
why: Dates were captured on 2026-11-16; rows need a clear status for a re-check.
options: A. Add 'last verified' and 'status' columns (already partly in place).
B. Add a re-check schedule (weekly) for the next 60 days.
C. Keep as is.

title: Split the events by value (guarantee per dollar of buy-in)
why: Value ranking helps compare events, but guarantees differ in structure and field size.
options: A. Show guarantee ÷ buy-in ratio as a sortable column (shown now, as a calculation).
B. Also show expected field size (not verified; would need a source).
C. Keep only the sortable raw values.

title: Repo housekeeping
why: README is one line, no LICENSE, no .gitignore (F25).
options: A. Add a README with the site link, sources and how to update data.
B. Add a LICENSE (choose type).
C. Add a .gitignore for OS and editor files.
recommend: A and C; B needs your license choice.
